text_block_list.text:
It was early summer,
in the midst of training day in and day out
for the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I would like to participate in a mock race
prior to the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A 3,200-meter race should be taking place
before long.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The competitors were all ones she would
likely stand shoulder-to-shoulder with in
the future. Hence,
she wished to test her strength in preparation
for what lay ahead.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (... Above all else.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Through that matter with Pisa,
I learned what manner of being brings
hope.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I have come to better understand just how
much light
such hope can kindle within people's
hearts.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(For the eternal peace of the Rose Kingdom,
a bearer of hope is truly indispensable.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (I must—become just that.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—...Forgive me, I was lost in thought.
At any rate,
let us treat this practice race as our
touchstone.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I wish to know the measure of my true
strength.
To know whether I am worthy to lead our
clan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(The Fan Appreciation Festival left me with
lingering regrets.
I realized that I lack the capacity to
accomplish everything on my own.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
('King Moss'—
an existence possessing overwhelming
prowess
and the strength to overcome adversity
single-handedly,
bringing hope to the people—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(If I lack the caliber to accomplish it alone,
then at the very least...
I must become one who brings hope to all
through "overwhelming strength.")

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Let me hear your thoughts.

That said, judging from her race record,
a slightly shorter distance would likely
allow her
to bring out her full potential.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
I have considered the distance myself.
However—considering the lineup of competitors,
even if it is a bit long,
I do not wish to miss this race.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To make the Rose Kingdom unshakeable.
To ensure the Rose Clan shines for all
eternity.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To become a king of overwhelming might.
—I consider this a battle necessary as the
very first step.

To stack up victories in the Senior year
and project an unshakeable presence across
the racing world—
this is by no means an easy feat.

Perhaps it is an expression of her resolve
to confront the steep road ahead.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Thank you.

And in the mock race held a few days
later—

The outcome proved far more bitter than
anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(To make the Rose Kingdom unshakeable...!
To grant our clan everlasting
brilliance...!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Just like the Wise King Moss,
I shall lead—with true strength!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(My legs feel heavy, my breath is... ngh!
—Victory is... slipping away!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Gah, daaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Running out of stamina on the final
stretch,
resulting in a crushing 11th-place defeat,
was it—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Even after brushing aside your counsel...
...How pathetic of me.
choice_data_list: However, that also revealed some a...

text_block_list.text:
If we compensate for what is lacking and
put everything in order before the Takarazuka
Kinen,
there will be no issue.
We still have time.
choice_data_list: Let us use this defeat as fuel for...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. ...I am sorry.
...——

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I thought I understood.
And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Am I so lacking, even in raw ability?)
